raw_artifacts.note: Captures, weights, binaries and logs stay outside Git. Digests cannot recover lost artifacts.

definition_of_done.expected: Strict saved-latent/companion admission and negative tests; same-input raw/display PixelUMM equality; F32 boundary controls exact; BF16 differences reported without widening 2e-5 tolerances or admitting continuation; zero instrumented native in-chain allocation/readback/wait counters; sampled 10% floor, process caps and swap-growth guard.
definition_of_done.observed: 53 Crystal examples and 43 Python tests pass. Four final CPU comparison commands return 0 for two exact F32 controls and 2 for two failing BF16 controls. Native and adapted source decoder outputs are byte-identical; all nine declared guarded GPU probes finish normally with zero swap growth. Diagnostics DoD passed; BF16 continuation gate did not.

evidence.signal: Raw and display outputs byte-identical over 53,084,160 values each, all finite; first 20 unblended frames exact. Saved latent, adapted gathered-tile MPS attention only.
All 138,240 cache-noise values exact on identical exported epsilon; no RNG-stream parity claim.
14 main captures exact. F32 cache comparison is against pre-BF16-store constituents; native K/V are prospective only.
Eight pre-QKV captures exact on identical F32 block inputs.
All 14 boundaries exceed unchanged 2e-5 tolerance. First main capture img.q_projection max error 0.0228195190; largest main error 0.5 at prospective V.
All eight pre-QKV boundaries fail. First img.mod_silu: 777/2048 outside tolerance, max 0.00031266361474990845. Source SiLU/modulation outputs BF16, LayerNorm and QKV inputs F32 under MPS autocast.

F32 SiLU matches native exactly. Output-only BF16 rounding still fails 410/2048; BF16 input plus BF16 output rounding matches source exactly. No native production precision fix or full-block inference follows from this.

Nine serialized guarded GPU probes finish normally, file-cache accounting and 10% floor retained, zero observed swap growth. Native tracked allocations/readbacks/preterminal waits zero, one terminal drain per chain. Opaque MPS resources and between-sample spikes remain outside guarantees.
43 Python tests, final Crystal formatting and diff check pass; separate final-crystal-spec.json records 53 passing Crystal examples.

Opaque MPS private allocations are not counted by named buffers; guard samples cannot bound between-poll spikes.
The F32 cache diagnostic uses pre-BF16-store constituents; native K/V are prospective, not a history append.
No fresh live encoder-to-DiT handoff, full T0 preprocessing parity, T1 continuation, or visual character/style qualification.
The clean scene art is prepared but not encoded.
